_about: Invented, synthetic utterances for the minor-affect false-positive cell (docs/governance/emotional-safety-note.md section 4, owner decision 2026-11-03). No household data, no real names, no real recordings: every line was written for this file. Shaped like speech-to-text output (lower case, little punctuation, fillers) because that is what the affect detectors see on the voice path. Grouped as split -> speaker (minor | adult: who the line imitates) -> label (neutral (no feeling of the speaker's own) | hard_negative (feeling words that are NOT the speaker's own feeling: idioms, someone else's feeling, negation, fiction, media, quotes) | positive (the speaker's own first-person feeling; the recall control, so a detector that never fires cannot pass). dev = what any detector fix may be tuned on; held_out = written in the same sitting BEFORE any measurement and never used to tune. Measured by scripts/perf/minor_affect_fp.py; pinned by services/zoe-data/tests/test_minor_affect_safety_cells.py.
